Users who rely on ChatGPT for quick visual searches can now add photos to conversations faster using a new gesture. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recent photos to conversations

Although iOS has had Visual Intelligence for nearly two years, the feature remains limited to newer iPhone models and is not available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT to perform similar visual searches, attaching photos previously required tapping the '+' button, then 'Photos,' and then selecting an image from the photo library.

Although this process isn't overly cumbersome, OpenAI this week introduced a convenient new gesture to make attaching recent photos to conversations even quicker.

According to OpenAI's Adam Fry on X, users can now long-press the '+' button to the left of the input field to bring up their four most recent photos.

From there, they can select one to attach to the conversation and then ask questions or include it as part of their prompt.

This week, the new gesture was rolled out alongside several other ChatGPT improvements, including a better grasp of the current time, faster loading and improved performance for long conversations on the web, and clearer interface messaging while users wait for network connectivity.

Have you used AI for visual searches? Feel free to share in the comments.
